title: CC: Tweaked More Weapon Variants Compat
description: Allows Computercraft turtles to hold More Weapon Variants' swords.
body: This datapack packaged as a mod adds compatibility between [CC: Tweaked](https://modrinth.com/mod/cc-tweaked) and [More Weapon Variants (MStV+)](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-weapon-variants) by allowing turtles to hold every diamond sword variant.
